auth_env_var_specs.name: SERVOSITY_API_TOKEN
auth_env_var_specs.description: Servosity API token. Get one from cp.servosity.com/user/.

auth_description: Generate at https://cp.servosity.com/user/ (button at the bottom of the page). The CLI sends `Authorization: Token <key>` (Django REST framework convention).

novel_features.name: Fleet attention rollup
novel_features.description: One screen merges admin attention + dirty repos + DRaaS-in-progress + open issues, ranked per-company, and persists each call so tomorrow can drift against today.

novel_features.name: Stale-backup offline query
novel_features.description: Slice the synced /reports/stale-backup-sets/ snapshot by reseller, company, age window, and backup engine — entirely offline once synced. Use --refresh to repull the CSV.

novel_features.name: Per-company snapshot
novel_features.description: Single command pulls a company's metadata + addresses + contracts + all backups across three engines + open issues + agent sessions into one human or --json view.

novel_features.name: Terminal-speed issue triage
novel_features.description: List open issues with filters, then batch ignore / archive / reactivate / comment in one invocation with --dry-run and typed exit codes.

novel_features.name: Snapshot drift
novel_features.description: Diff two snapshots the CLI itself collected (attention, stale, dirty-repos) — show what got worse and what recovered between two timestamps.

novel_features.name: Cross-engine backup facts
novel_features.description: Query a unified view (engine + id + company_id + last_successful_at + last_status + size_bytes) over all three backup engines synced into the local store.

novel_features.name: Cross-table FTS find
novel_features.description: SQLite FTS5 across companies (name, billing notes), issues (title and comments), and backups (descriptive name, last error) — one query hits the whole fleet.

novel_features.name: Restore-queue oversight
novel_features.description: List per-company restore queues across companies the local store knows about; --watch repolls and prints diffs.

novel_features.name: Clear company or partner (until time)
novel_features.description: Resolve one or more names as companies (then resellers) and batch-ignore their active issues until a human-readable time. Defaults to --dry-run for production safety.

novel_features.name: Stale-issue cleanup (per support engineer)
novel_features.description: Pull your FMDB companies, fetch active issues, classify known-safe-to-archive patterns from a shipped rule table, auto-archive the safe ones, ignore non-dashboard noise, and print unknowns for review. Defaults to --dry-run.
